name: Manipal Payment and Identity S
summary: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited operates as a smart card manufacturer in India, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Asia-Pacific, Africa, North America, South America and internationally. The company offers solutions for cards, including banking, identity solutions, and loyalty cards; encompass card manufacturing, card personalization, cheque book printing, the supply of related collaterals, tax stamps, holograms, thermal paper rolls, and RFID products; and handles fulfilment activities, such as dispatch services.
